title: Trump cancels Bedminster trip over drones
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Trump cancels Bedminster trip over drones, about December 2024 at Bedminster, New Jersey, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Donald J Trump the next American president had to skip his trip to his Bedminster New Jersey summer home because of these New Jersey drones

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in December 2024 Donald Trump, then about to become president again, had to skip a trip to his summer home in Bedminster, New Jersey. According to Michels, the reason was the mysterious drones being reported over New Jersey at the time. If true, it would show the sightings were taken seriously at the highest level.
